payload.text: The estate page (served by intentd, started 2026-11-01 06:18Z without CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR) sees no Claude sessions, so it labels every running slot ORPHANED; reproduced by running the census with the variable unset (0 sessions, every slot orphaned) against 24 with it set. The CLI census (intent estate status) is the desk's truth: never revoke a slot on the page's word. Recorded for Intent through intent-vc; decision 98's at-login enrolment must carry the variable; no work on it under hv's no-yaks word. On 2026-11-05 hv's restart from a terminal without the variable changed nothing; vc restarted intentd at 07:25Z from its own shell (intent daemon stop and start, stdin from /dev/null), and the page named every holder. That restart lasts until the next login; Intent issue 0671 holds the fix.
